title: Project Architecture & Quickstart
description: Start here to understand the Amharic sentiment pipeline architecture, transformer fine-tuning background, and available CLI/GUI entrypoints.

title: Ge'ez Orthographic Normalization
description: Examine how Amharic spelling variations, homophones (ሐ/ኀ/ሀ, ሠ/ሰ, ዐ/አ, ፀ/ጸ), labiovelar reductions, and character elongations are cleaned in O(N) time.

title: Neural Sequence Classification Engine
description: Explore the SentimentInferenceEngine loading fine-tuned AfriBERTa weights, executing pure PyTorch tensor forward passes, and handling multi-clause discourse boundaries.

title: Decoupled Dual-Axis Calibration Logic
description: Inspect the mathematical calibration mapping positive and negative polar probabilities into calibrated confidence percentages and resolving Positive, Negative, Neutral, and Mixed categories.

title: Desktop Studio GUI & Terminal CLI
description: See how PySide6 (Qt6) and Typer/Rich harness the engine for interactive REPL queries, live visual sentiment gauges, theme switching, and batch execution.

title: Golden Benchmark & Automated Verification
description: Review the 10-case Golden Benchmark dataset and comprehensive Pytest test suites guaranteeing 100% accuracy and strict regression safety.
